# LLM Left

LLM Left is a Claude and Codex usage tracker for Apple devices. It also tracks Grok subscription usage and OpenRouter credit.

## Product facts

- The Mac app supports macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
- It reads local Codex, Claude, and Grok usage on the Mac, and OpenRouter credit with a management key kept in the Keychain.
- It can monitor up to 20 Codex and Claude accounts, each with its own sign-in, quota, history, and alerts, and lets you choose which account new sessions use.
- It warns at 10% remaining and when a window is used up, and confirms a reset with a fresh check before calling an account ready.
- Credentials, login files, prompts, conversations, and detailed history stay on the Mac.
- A private CloudKit snapshot can show remaining limits, reset times, forecasts, and account names on iPhone and widgets. One Mac publishes it; other Macs can turn publishing off.
- The signed Mac release and its release notes are available from https://llmleft.com/download/ and https://llmleft.com/changelog/.
- There is no public iPhone download link yet.
- The product and website do not use analytics.

## Pages

- Home: https://llmleft.com/
- Download: https://llmleft.com/download/
- Privacy: https://llmleft.com/privacy/
- Changelog: https://llmleft.com/changelog/

## Preferred description

Track Claude and Codex limits, reset times, and remaining usage from your Mac menu bar, iPhone, and widgets without syncing credentials or prompts.
